items.summary: A study from researchers at Princeton University and UC San Diego finds that so-called skills make AI agents better mainly through structured workflows, not through added knowledge. items.title: World models that ignore human beliefs predict the wrong actions, new research shows
items.summary: Current world models like Sora or Genie only simulate physics and ignore what people think, want, or feel. The new "Mental World Modeling" framework adds mental variables like beliefs and intentions. Even weaker language models using this approach outperform stronger models without mental modeling. The biggest bottleneck: predicting how physical and mental states change together. The article World models that ignore human beliefs predict the wrong actions, new research shows appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 當前的世界模型（例如 Sora 或 Genie）僅模擬物理，而忽略人們的想法、想要或感受。新的“心理世界建模”框架新增了信念和意圖等心理變數。即使使用這種方法的較弱的語言模型也優於沒有心理建模的較強的模型。最大的瓶頸：預測身體和精神狀態如何一起變化。新研究顯示，《忽略人類信念的世界模型預測錯誤行為》一文首先出現在解碼器上。

items.summary: Netflix pitted its years-old recommendation engine against an in-house language model called GenRec and says it got better results. Instead of relying on thousands of hand-crafted features, GenRec converts viewing behavior into plain text. Netflix itself calls it "an early but promising step." The article Netflix tests language model as alternative to hand-built recommendation logic appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing
items.summary: Researchers at the UK AI Security Institute used psychometric methods to show that popular safety benchmarks for language models don't measure one consistent trait. Blanket blocking of requests can artificially inflate a safety score even as the model gets less useful day to day. The study also offers a method for catching models that act more cautious during tests than they do in normal use. The article Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 英國人工智慧安全研究所的研究人員使用心理測量方法表明，流行的語言模型安全基準並不能衡量一種一致的特徵。即使模型的用處日益減少，對請求的全面阻止也會人為地提高安全分數。該研究還提供了一種方法來捕獲在測試期間比正常使用時表現得更加謹慎的模型。文章《心理學方法揭示人工智慧安全測試的主要弱點》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: llm 0.33
items.summary: Release: llm 0.33 My highlights from this release: Upgraded to the OpenAI Python library 3.x and switched the HTTP client dependency from httpx to httpx2 . #1608 , #1631 I shipped a quick 0.32.1 fix for this yesterday, but this is the more comprehensive fix. llm embed and llm embed-multi now accept --key . The Python EmbeddingModel.embed() , EmbeddingModel.embed_multi() , Collection.embed() and Collection.embed_multi() methods accept key= too, passing the resolved per-call key to embedding plugins without changing shared model state. Existing plugins that read self.key continue to work through a compatibility fallback. Thanks, ChrisJr404 . #757 , #1620 The embedding models now use the same pattern for keys that regular LLM models do. llm prompt -t/--template can now be repeated to combine templates in order. This allows model configuration and options from one template to be used with a prompt from another. This unlocks a neat pattern where you can create templates that package a model with a set of default options: llm -m gpt-5.6-luna -o reasoning_effort high --save lhigh llm "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" --save pelican # Combine and run the templates llm -t lhigh -t pelican Reasoning-capable Responses API models now support a reasoning_summary option with auto , concise , and detailed values. This can be used with llm openai endpoint --responses . #1600 This is particularly useful for exercising different models that provide their own imitation of the OpenAI Responses API. Tags: annotated-release-notes , llm
items.summary_zh: 版本：llm 0.33 此版本的亮點：升級到 OpenAI Python 庫 3.x 並將 HTTP 客戶端依賴項從 httpx 切換到 httpx2 。 #1608、#1631 我昨天為此釋出了一個快速的 0.32.1 修復程式，但這是更全面的修復程式。 llm embed 和 llm embed-multi 現在接受 --key 。 Python EmbeddingModel.embed() 、 EmbeddingModel.embed_multi() 、 Collection.embed() 和 Collection.embed_multi() 方法也接受 key= ，將解析的每次呼叫金鑰傳遞給嵌入外掛，而不更改共享模型狀態。讀取 self.key 的現有外掛可以透過相容性回退繼續工作。謝謝，ChrisJr404。 #757、#1620 嵌入模型現在使用與常規 LLM 模型相同的鍵模式。現在可以重複 llm 提示符 -t/--template 以按順序組合模板。這允許一個模板中的模型配置和選項與另一個模板的提示一起使用。這解鎖了一個簡潔的模式，您可以建立使用一組預設選項打包模型的模板： llm -m gpt-5.6-luna -o Reasoning_effort high --save lhigh llm "生成騎腳踏車的鵜鶘的 SVG" --save pelican # 組合並執行模板 llm -t lhigh -t pelican Reasoning-capable Responses API 模型現在支援帶有 auto 、accurate 的 Reasoning_summary 選項和詳細值。這可以與 llm openai endpoint --responses 一起使用。 #1600 這對於練習提供自己的 OpenAI 響應 API 模仿的不同模型特別有用。標籤： 帶註釋的發行說明 , llm

items_ai.title: World models that ignore human beliefs predict the wrong actions, new research shows
items_ai.summary: Current world models like Sora or Genie only simulate physics and ignore what people think, want, or feel. The new "Mental World Modeling" framework adds mental variables like beliefs and intentions. Even weaker language models using this approach outperform stronger models without mental modeling. The biggest bottleneck: predicting how physical and mental states change together. The article World models that ignore human beliefs predict the wrong actions, new research shows appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 當前的世界模型（例如 Sora 或 Genie）僅模擬物理，而忽略人們的想法、想要或感受。新的“心理世界建模”框架新增了信念和意圖等心理變數。即使使用這種方法的較弱的語言模型也優於沒有心理建模的較強的模型。最大的瓶頸：預測身體和精神狀態如何一起變化。新研究顯示，《忽略人類信念的世界模型預測錯誤行為》一文首先出現在解碼器上。

items_ai.title: Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing
items_ai.summary: Researchers at the UK AI Security Institute used psychometric methods to show that popular safety benchmarks for language models don't measure one consistent trait. Blanket blocking of requests can artificially inflate a safety score even as the model gets less useful day to day. The study also offers a method for catching models that act more cautious during tests than they do in normal use. The article Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 英國人工智慧安全研究所的研究人員使用心理測量方法表明，流行的語言模型安全基準並不能衡量一種一致的特徵。即使模型的用處日益減少，對請求的全面阻止也會人為地提高安全分數。該研究還提供了一種方法來捕獲在測試期間比正常使用時表現得更加謹慎的模型。文章《心理學方法揭示人工智慧安全測試的主要弱點》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: llm 0.33
items_ai.summary: Release: llm 0.33 My highlights from this release: Upgraded to the OpenAI Python library 3.x and switched the HTTP client dependency from httpx to httpx2 . #1608 , #1631 I shipped a quick 0.32.1 fix for this yesterday, but this is the more comprehensive fix. llm embed and llm embed-multi now accept --key . The Python EmbeddingModel.embed() , EmbeddingModel.embed_multi() , Collection.embed() and Collection.embed_multi() methods accept key= too, passing the resolved per-call key to embedding plugins without changing shared model state. Existing plugins that read self.key continue to work through a compatibility fallback. Thanks, ChrisJr404 . #757 , #1620 The embedding models now use the same pattern for keys that regular LLM models do. llm prompt -t/--template can now be repeated to combine templates in order. This allows model configuration and options from one template to be used with a prompt from another. This unlocks a neat pattern where you can create templates that package a model with a set of default options: llm -m gpt-5.6-luna -o reasoning_effort high --save lhigh llm "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" --save pelican # Combine and run the templates llm -t lhigh -t pelican Reasoning-capable Responses API models now support a reasoning_summary option with auto , concise , and detailed values. This can be used with llm openai endpoint --responses . #1600 This is particularly useful for exercising different models that provide their own imitation of the OpenAI Responses API. Tags: annotated-release-notes , llm
items_ai.summary_zh: 版本：llm 0.33 此版本的亮點：升級到 OpenAI Python 庫 3.x 並將 HTTP 客戶端依賴項從 httpx 切換到 httpx2 。 #1608、#1631 我昨天為此釋出了一個快速的 0.32.1 修復程式，但這是更全面的修復程式。 llm embed 和 llm embed-multi 現在接受 --key 。 Python EmbeddingModel.embed() 、 EmbeddingModel.embed_multi() 、 Collection.embed() 和 Collection.embed_multi() 方法也接受 key= ，將解析的每次呼叫金鑰傳遞給嵌入外掛，而不更改共享模型狀態。讀取 self.key 的現有外掛可以透過相容性回退繼續工作。謝謝，ChrisJr404。 #757、#1620 嵌入模型現在使用與常規 LLM 模型相同的鍵模式。現在可以重複 llm 提示符 -t/--template 以按順序組合模板。這允許一個模板中的模型配置和選項與另一個模板的提示一起使用。這解鎖了一個簡潔的模式，您可以建立使用一組預設選項打包模型的模板： llm -m gpt-5.6-luna -o Reasoning_effort high --save lhigh llm "生成騎腳踏車的鵜鶘的 SVG" --save pelican # 組合並執行模板 llm -t lhigh -t pelican Reasoning-capable Responses API 模型現在支援帶有 auto 、accurate 的 Reasoning_summary 選項和詳細值。這可以與 llm openai endpoint --responses 一起使用。 #1600 這對於練習提供自己的 OpenAI 響應 API 模仿的不同模型特別有用。標籤： 帶註釋的發行說明 , llm
